**Validator Name:** Cogwheel

Cogwheel is blockchain validator that is has been active since 2023. Cogwheel always tries to contribute to the ecosystem by providing documentations for node deployment, writing blogs and how to guides, provide public endpoints such as REST,gRPC,RPC and WSS on Cosmos SDK based networks. Alongside these services we do provide apps and services that are unique and give users a way of interacting with the blockchain such as the Spectra Explorer, Spectra Portal, Dyson Frontend, and in the future probably even more apps and services will come online.

**Networks Currently Validating:**

Atom One, Celestia, Nibiru Chain, Voi Network, Juno, Nolus

**Why Are We Interested in Validating on Gno.land:**
Gnoland provides a unique approach to smart contracts. It is unique and interesting. It would be an great honor to be a part of it.

**Contributions to gno.land:**

Was involved into multiple gnoland testnets as a validator.
The Spectra Explorer: https://thespectra.io/gnoland_onyx (testnet)

Spectra Gnoland Indexer: Although the explorer is closed source, the indexer that will be used for the data collection is open source under Apache 2.0 at: https://github.com/Cogwheel-Validator/spectra-gnoland-indexer. The indexer also comes with the REST API to give any developer a easy starting point.

When Gnoland incorporates IBC protocol we will integrate the blockchain into the Spectra Portal app, link: https://portal.thespectra.io github: https://github.com/Cogwheel-Validator/spectra-portal, where user should be able to bridge the tokens.

AviaOne.com 🟢 is a trusted professional validator since 2020 with security-focused infrastructure, having contributed to the development of Gno.land code.

Until 2024, we operated over 50 nodes, including more than 20 mainnets. 2024 has been a challenging year for the blockchain validation industry. Rather than spreading resources thin across many networks, AviaOne has made the strategic decision to focus on fewer, high-quality blockchain partnerships.

Our main contribution to the Cosmos ecosystem is [AviaOne BlockChains Service (ABS)](https://aviaone.com/blockchains-service/), a live index and verification engine for 370+ Cosmos blockchains (mainnets and testnets). It tests RPC/API endpoints, latency and binary versions every 3 hours, and provides interactive node setup guides and CLI resources for developers and operators.

We have participated in all Gno.land testnets and contributed to the core codebase by introducing the [seed node mechanism](https://github.com/gnolang/gno/pull/6023) used by validators to interconnect.

We maintain [GnoVisor](https://github.com/AviaOne/gnovisor), an upgrade supervisor that handles Gno.land node upgrades, including governance halts, automatically, [GnoDuty](https://github.com/AviaOne/GnoDuty), a monitoring tool that tracks validator activity in real time, running live on [our own node](https://gnoduty.aviaone.com/), and [Tenderseed](https://github.com/AviaOne/tenderseed), a tool to deploy seed nodes across Cosmos SDK and Gno.land chains.

### Why validating on Gno.land

As active validators since 2020, we believe Gno.land opens new horizons for next-generation blockchains, and we did not want to miss such a milestone.

**Motivation and contribution:**
We're keen to validate on Gno.land, a platform that embodies an innovative vision of smart contracts. Its approach, focused on simplicity, security, and developer experience, aligns perfectly with our ethos. Choosing Go as our native language marks a technological breakthrough that we want to actively support. Gno.land has the potential to redefine the standards of decentralized development, and we want to be part of this evolution from the start.
